detail.title: CP-UNP-D2521L10-DAQ
detail.overview: 2MP WDR 25x IR Network PTZ Camera- 100 Mtr.
features: WDR(120dB), Day/Night(ICR), 2D NR/ 3D NR, Defog, AWB, AGC, BLC, HLC
Up to 300 Presets, 5 Scan, 8 Tour, 5 Pattern
IR Range of 100 Mtr., IP66, PoE
CMS Software: KVMS Pro Lite, EVMS Pro

General.Minimum Illumination: 0.005 lux@F1.6 (Color, 30 IRE), 0.0005 lux@F1.6 (B/W, 30 IRE), 0 lux (IR light)
General.White Balance: Auto, Indoor, Outdoor, Tracking, Manual, Sodium  lamp, Natural light, Street lamp
General.Bit Rate: H265: 86 kbps–5632 kbps, H264: 256 kbps–8192 kbps

Channel Title, Time Title, OSD Info (PTZ Coordinate, Zoom, North, Pattern, Temperature,
Preset, Location, Input Text, Text Alignment), Font Properties, Custom Title, Exception Overlay

General.Special Features: Up to 300 Presets, 5 Pattern, 8  (up to 32 presets per tour) Tour, 5 Scan
General.Frame Rate:
Main stream: 2MP (1920 × 1080)@1–25fps, 720p, D1@1–25fps
Sub stream 1: D1/CIF@1–25fps,
Sub stream 2: 2MP (1920 × 1080)@1–25fps, 720p, D1@1–25fps
Sub stream 3: D1/CIF@1–25fps,
Sub stream 4: D1/CIF@1–25fps
